offer.text: The hives are heavy and my ladder is not what it was. Six bottles of honey, {player}, and I will not forget it.

accept.text: Mind the smoke, and mind your fingers.

decline.text: No shame in it. Bees frighten better folk than you.

in_progress.text: Still buzzing about it, are you?

ready.text: Six bottles! Set them down before you drop them.

complete.text: That is the winter's sweetening seen to. Thank you.

failed.text: Too late — the comb went to the ants.

cooldown.text: You have already emptied my hives this week. Let them work.

locked.text: Perhaps when I know you a little better.
